criteria.text: Diagnosis of familial chylomicronemia syndrome (FCS) (approval criterion 3).
Patient is at least 18 years old (approval criterion 1).
Prescribed by or in consultation with a cardiologist or endocrinologist (approval criterion 2).
At least one: genetic confirmation of biallelic pathogenic FCS variants (LPL, APOA5, APOC2, LMF1, etc.), Moulin score ≥10, or North American FCS (NAFCS) score ≥45 (approval criterion 4).
Tried conventional TG-lowering therapy (statin, fibrates, etc.) and failed to achieve a TG reduction >20% from baseline (approval criterion 5).
Secondary hypertriglyceridemia from other known sources (chronic kidney disease, uncontrolled diabetes, medication side-effects, etc.) ruled out (approval criterion 6).
Provider attests patient will follow a low-fat diet concomitantly with Redemplo (approval criterion 7).
Patient is not currently and will not be taking olezarsen while taking Redemplo (denial criterion 2).

notes: Partial encoding from Alaska Medicaid Redemplo (plozasiran) Criteria Version 1: Original 2/27/2026; Accepted 4/17/2026; Effective 6/1/2026.

Encoded: closed FCS indication, approval criteria 1–7, and denial criterion 2. Denial criterion 1 (failure to meet approval criteria) is represented by approval clauses. Clinical documentation attestations require manual review.
Conventional TG-lowering therapy failure means not achieving >20% TG reduction from baseline; exactly 20% reduction meets the failure definition.

Cautions (notes only): diet should contain ≥20g of fat per day, with no more than 15%–20% of daily calories from fat. Common adverse reactions include hyperglycemia, headache, nausea, and injection site reactions.
Duration (notes only): initial approval up to 3 months; reauthorization approval up to 12 months.
Quantity limit (notes only): one 25mg/0.5ml prefilled syringe every 84 days. Numeric quantity enforcement is not encoded.
Documentation verification, cautions, duration, reauthorization and quantity limits require manual review.
